test_title: PYST 22: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the bracketed word to fill in the blank.

The rainbow arched gracefully across the sky, painting it in ________ (lifeless) hues.
solution:
The correct answer is '**vibrant**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**vibrant**" means full of energy and life. (जीवन्त)
 
• The rainbow is often associated with bright and vivid colors, which are full of life.
 
• The other options: "**spiritual**," "**ashless**," and "**muted**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The rainbow arched gracefully across the sky, painting it in vibrant__ hues.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Spiritual (आध्यात्मिक)**: relating to or affecting the human spirit or soul.
 
• **Ashless (राख रहित)**: not containing ash, not relevant in this context.
 
• **Muted (मंद)**: quiet and soft in color or sound, the opposite of vibrant.
